from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    """Metadata for a single judgment document."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The official title or name of the judgment document")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The legal cause of action or procedural nature of the case described in the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Root class for parsing a single document."""
    documents: list[DocumentInfo]
